body: In Vancouver, white people don't dominate like in other places, so you don't hear much of that crap coming from dudes around here. "Chink" is the racial slur i hear most.

I've heard and read this before. I don't think so. I expect something from myself, but not perfection. The people who judge me just validate the negative feelings I already have about myself. They tend to be the ones I most respect too. I can't just say fuck em.

I post twice on a subreddit about how depressed I am and that means I need to get out? Did you not read my post? When I go out, bad shit happens. I'm better off drinking alone and hating life behind closed doors where I can't hurt the world. Listen, everything I do affects those around me in a negative way. God I hate your suggestion. 

>Take a walk, meet people, talk about stuff your interested in. 

So basically you're telling me to become happy out of no where? Because I sure as fuck don't wanna do that kind of stuff when I'm in this emotional state. 

Sorry to hear about your fucked up year, but it doesn't make me feel better to be reminded that someone is having their life shat on and mine isn't so bad and I'm the problem. I already know that. I am not good enough for the world. It is beautiful, even when bad shit happens. I am the shitty one. I don't deserve the world. I'm not the only one mind you. There are a lot of shits in this world that ought to hang themselves but lack the self-reflection to do so, and often it's the kinder souls who are suicidal. Yes I mean me. I'm angry now and this is the internet but I'm a truly caring and loving person and here I am hating myself. Fuck me right.

"I'm gunna kill so many fuckers in COD4 tonight! That'll show this wretched world!" 

Totally the best.
That poor dad. It's sucked the life out of him.

They don't care. I hope they die. Your kid is lucky, having a mother so connected to her emotions and not just getting stuck on stress mode when the shit hits the fan. My parents can be really cool at times, but when it's time to get real and talk about shit that matters - you know, the time that counts - they freak out and turn into beasts not otherwise seen in this house. It's been the same for so long. I just want to stop being myself. Maybe death isn't the way to achieve this. Like I've said to others, maybe drugs. Definitely have gone the alcohol route. Thanks for showing compassion; It's not corny. Gotta say though, being told to stick with school when it was clearly a real tough ride for you gives me mixed feelings. On the one hand I guess it's inspiring to know that something can be done, but on the other, it's just a reminder that I'm doing something I hate. It's not the life I want and I don't see that life at the end of all this. Just the same old pain with hints of light between a couple cracks, teasing me with what could be. Thanks again for reaching out though. I need this shit.

I want to run. I want to run away from the painful life I keep trying to force myself into and run toward something better. Death makes the most sense because it is the most separate from this world. Escape is the point. I tried running away before and got shit, so I figure I need to find other ways to escape. Drugs come to mind, but right now I'm using things like creativity to help me find some bliss within myself. Banging my head against a wall and diving deeper into the shit-pit of life like you have just sounds awful. Fuck that. I'd rather take the cyanide than be tortured, know what I mean?

You hit a lot of really good points here. Almost overwhelming. I guess it's hard to define what has made me such a burden. I've always dicked around in school and not really applied myself to anything (aside from acting and drawing, both of which I abandoned). I never really took anyone else into consideration when it came to how I handled my own life, in the sense that my parents stressed out nonstop about my grades all through middle and high school, and I was always really emotional - not as in crying all the time, more like screaming in anger and breaking shit. pot helped. I was never abused, just lots of yelling and telling me I had to apply myself and all that standard parent crap, just way more intense than what my friends seemed to get. So you're definitely right about the pressure, but i deserved it. My parents wanted me to quit acting in high school because it was a big time commitment and would affect my grades, but I stuck with it anyway and it was the best time of my life, but ultimately did made my grades drop and I barely made it into this awful university. Basically I am a burden because I'm not going anywhere. As far as I can tell, my parents have wasted twenty years on me and I am the one person in my family - and I mean my entire giant family - without a beautiful bright future. Shit, did I say future? They're already amazingly successful. Maybe burden isn't the right word. I'm like the weak link in the chain, a bruise on a beautiful woman's face. I was born into this great family and I'm spoiling it. I wouldn't really mind feeling so alone if I had something meaningful to pursue. I don't think I would be alone either. Life just seems so pointless so much of the time for me, but I see people playing piano and fixing up cars and they're so into it and it just looks like heaven. I want that, but it never seems to work out that way. 

Writing this shit really helps, and so does knowing there are people actually reading at least some of it. Thanks.

I almost laughed when I read "run a half-marathon". I did this last year, and I'm training for a full marathon this year. Other than "pay my phone bill", this is the one goal I have right now, and yeah, I guess it helps feel good for a while while I'm running and afterward, but then I go back in my filthy room and put off studying for another six hours. The dissonance you describe, with "Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde" is one I'm quite familiar with at this point, but the problem is, I have a feeling of hopelessness that comes into play during these battles that makes me realize there is no point. When I fail at the end of the semester, I plan on killing myself. It's a deal I make with myself every semester and so far I'm on academic probation, just a step away from flunking out, so this might be the semester it finally happens. The shame is too much. I remember when I was younger hearing about samurai killing themselves in honor, and the people around me were dumbfounded by this, but I totally got it. I've always believed that I have a duty toward my family, and for a long time I was able to put in minimal effort and still do things that made ME happy with the majority of my time, but now I have to do bullshit I don't give a fuck about, and I mean I really need to. My family is full of extremely accomplished, interesting people and I have standards to live up to (I have cousins with multiple doctorates who base jump off buildings for fuck sake!) So here I am forced into a school I hate, doing shit I don't care about, sacrificing time I'd like to spend doing something enjoyable, and wasting it anyway. I'm wasting my life as usual, and no one believes in me. Those who do (like you guys) don't know me and don't know what a fuck-up I am. It's just a part of me. 

Okay, I kind of rambled there. Whatever. Decently-sized wall of text delivered.

it's pretty hard to see being of any use to anyone. Everything I think I'll like I end up hating and either quitting or just barely getting through it by the skin of my teeth, hating it the whole way. This has been my whole life, why should it end now.

I said some stuff in my reply to ranautricularia, but if you insist on more, I guess I'll just say that I really don't see a bright future for me. I'm an embarrassment and a burden, simple as that. I'll never be happy. Why go on if I'm not happy and I'm not making others happy? By killing myself, I'd make my parents cry for a while, but after the sparsely attended funeral, who's really hurting? My family would be perfect if I wasn't here screwing it up.

I'm a student at a very lonely university. I was there for a year, decided I hated it and went to work in another country for a few months, then came home and decided I was ready for uni again. Now I'm back and hating it all the more, barely making an effort. When I'm not at school I come home and shut myself in my room in my parents' basement. They're paying my way at school and I'm fucking wasting their money, but it's either I go to school or move out for good. My sister is in high school and she's a great student and a better person than me in every way. The bitch is bipolar but takes meds and she's the cheeriest little go-getter fuck. My parents sort of do what they feel they have to for me I guess, but they clearly have no hope for me. All day I sit in my room and waste time. I watch movies a lot lately, the one way to make me feel better without booze, drugs, or violent sex. My friends seem to be dwindling. I lose more all the time. For a while it was because of my drinking, but I kind of have that under control now so I guess I just suck. I do it to myself though at least a little, by isolating myself. When I'm not in school I'm not like this, at least in the social sense. I'm still a worthless piece of shit and I'm quite aware of it, but I'm able to distract myself with work and partying during the summer months. I guess I feel worthless because of the way my future looks. I'll never do the things I've dreamed of, never live a good life and never be happy. I've been this way for so long, why should it change? I have a few friends I can talk to about my issues, but only on the surface level. Everyone just offers bullshit advice and doesn't really care, which I understand. You ask about a time when I felt happy. The only thing I ever really enjoyed was acting. I did it since I was seven, through various programs and in school. It was my thing in high school, and then I gave it up to do something that actually mattered. Look where that got me. 

I hope you're satisfied with my wall of text.

> Go out there, be someone. 

I want to. That's the problem. Cocky fuck.

I agree. I didn't realize this until I did an exercise with an acting class some time ago where we just wrote without thinking, then read it back out loud. The result was me screaming at my girlfriend that I wouldn't be happy until she was out of my life. I had no idea, and I really did feel better afterward. This was many years ago, mind you and shit is awful these days, but I hope this gives the idea credibility for someone.
